eligibility_evidence: Role Description The Junior ICT Engineer role is a full-time, on-site position based in Giza.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Established in 1986 in Cairo, Egypt as a shareholding company and registered as an Engineering House of Expertise, EGEC quickly earned recognition as one of Egypt’s leading consultancy firms. About the Role We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Junior ICT Engineer with hands-on BIM modeling skills to join our engineering team. Qualifications & Requirements Education: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Electronics & Communications, or Computer Engineering. Experience: 2 to3 years of relevant experience (fresh graduates with strong graduation projects or internships in BIM/ICT design are welcome). Software (Must-Have): Proficiency in Autodesk Revit (MEP/BIM modeling) is mandatory. Basic proficiency in AutoCAD and Navisworks is a plus.
